label: AUKUS 核潜艇协议（2021）
description: 2021年9月15日，美国政治媒体 Politico 率先披露美英澳三国将宣布新的安全伙伴关系 AUKUS，随后美英澳三国领导人正式宣布澳大利亚将获得核潜艇技术，法国因失去与澳方的常规潜艇合同而召回驻美澳大使。澳大利亚、英国、法国、中国、德国、俄罗斯媒体相继跟进。标注依据为公开报道时间线：首发为美国媒体（2021-09-15）。

articles.title: U.S., U.K. and Australia to announce new security pact focused on Indo-Pacific
articles.content: The United States, Britain and Australia are set to announce a new trilateral security partnership aimed at countering China in the Indo-Pacific, officials familiar with the plan said Wednesday. The pact, known as AUKUS, will include sharing of nuclear submarine technology with Australia. A joint announcement by the three leaders is expected within hours.

articles.title: Australia to acquire nuclear-powered submarines under historic AUKUS pact
articles.content: Australia will acquire nuclear-powered submarines for the first time under a landmark security partnership with the United States and Britain, Prime Minister Scott Morrison announced. The decision means Australia is scrapping a 90-billion-dollar conventional submarine deal with France. The first submarines are expected to be built in Adelaide.

articles.title: Aukus: UK, US and Australia launch pact to counter China
articles.content: The UK, US and Australia have announced a historic security pact in the Asia-Pacific, in what's seen as an effort to counter China. The Aukus alliance will let Australia build nuclear-powered submarines for the first time, using technology provided by the US. China has criticised the deal as extremely irresponsible.

articles.title: Aukus : la France dénonce un « coup dans le dos » après la perte du contrat des sous-marins
articles.content: La France a vivement dénoncé mercredi l'annonce du partenariat Aukus entre les États-Unis, le Royaume-Uni et l'Australie, qui entraîne l'annulation d'un méga-contrat de sous-marins français avec Canberra. Le ministre des Affaires étrangères a évoqué un « coup dans le dos ». Paris a convoqué une réunion de crise.

articles.title: 外交部：美英澳核潜艇合作严重破坏地区和平稳定
articles.content: 中国外交部发言人16日表示，美英澳三国宣布开展核潜艇合作，严重破坏地区和平稳定，加剧军备竞赛，损害国际核不扩散努力。中方敦促三国摒弃冷战思维和狭隘地缘政治观念。发言人指出，中方将密切关注事态发展。

articles.title: Aukus-Bündnis: Frankreich verärgert über geplatzten U-Boot-Deal
articles.content: Das neue Sicherheitsbündnis Aukus zwischen den USA, Großbritannien und Australien sorgt für diplomatische Spannungen. Frankreich verliert dadurch einen milliardenschweren U-Boot-Auftrag aus Australien und spricht von einem Vertrauensbruch. Die EU kündigte an, die Auswirkungen auf ihre Indopazifik-Strategie zu prüfen.

articles.title: В Москве прокомментировали создание альянса AUKUS
articles.content: В Кремле заявили, что внимательно следят за созданием нового партнерства AUKUS между США, Великобританией и Австралией. Российские официальные лица призвали к оценке сделки с точки зрения режима нераспространения. Ранее Австралия объявила об отказе от контракта с Францией на подводные лодки.

articles.title: Apple iPhone 13 preorders open with record carrier subsidies
articles.content: Preorders for Apple's iPhone 13 lineup opened Wednesday with major carriers offering aggressive trade-in deals. Analysts expect the new models to drive a strong upgrade cycle through the holiday quarter. Deliveries begin next week.

articles.title: 全国秋粮收购工作会议召开
articles.content: 国家粮食和物资储备局16日召开全国秋粮收购工作会议，部署秋粮收购各项工作。会议要求各地落实收购资金，优化为农服务，守住农民“种粮卖得出”底线。今年秋粮丰收已成定局。
